acceptance: Red test first: an auth_recheck (or credential-wall) bench on a family clears when a bridge probe of that family succeeds (doctor live, the usage probe, or a phase launch that reaches the REPL), and the clear is recorded as a signal.
A failed probe keeps the bench.
Docs in STE: the clihealth package note records which successes clear which bench reasons.

fix: 2026-11-02: the claude CLI lost its login twice (waves 147 and 149). After the operator re-logged in, the claude family kept an auth_recheck bench until 22:47+08 although `evolve doctor live claude-tmux` answered LIVE OK (served claude-opus-5-5). The bench orders claude last, so lanes walked into the exhausted agy pools and paused on quota. The loop log also showed 'credential wall on the cli-health bench ... the bench clears itself once a probe succeeds', but no successful probe cleared it; the console had to run `evolve clihealth clear claude`. A successful probe of the family must clear its auth bench.
